parameters.query:
WITH pendiente AS (
  SELECT id, especialidad, especialidad_id
  FROM solicitudes_citas
  WHERE estado = 'pendiente' AND doctor_id IS NULL
  ORDER BY CASE urgencia WHEN 'alta' THEN 1 WHEN 'normal' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, id
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),
esp AS (
  SELECT p.id AS cita_id, COALESCE(p.especialidad_id, e.id) AS esp_id
  FROM pendiente p
  LEFT JOIN especialidades e
    ON lower(e.nombre) = lower(CASE WHEN p.especialidad = 'General' THEN 'Medicina General' ELSE p.especialidad END)
),
elegido AS (
  SELECT s.slot, u.id AS doctor_id
  FROM esp
  JOIN usuarios u ON u.rol = 'doctor' AND u.activo AND u.especialidad_id = esp.esp_id
  JOIN especialidades e2 ON e2.id = u.especialidad_id AND e2.activo
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
    date_trunc('hour', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + INTERVAL '1 hour',
    date_trunc('hour', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + INTERVAL '14 days',
    INTERVAL '30 minutes') AS s(slot)
  WHERE EXTRACT(isodow FROM s.slot) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    AND s.slot::time BETWEEN TIME '14:00' AND TIME '22:30'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM solicitudes_citas c
      WHERE c.doctor_id = u.id AND c.estado <> 'cancelada'
        AND tsrange(c.horario_asignado, c.horario_asignado + INTERVAL '30 minutes')
            && tsrange(s.slot, s.slot + INTERVAL '30 minutes')
    )
  ORDER BY s.slot, u.id
  LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE solicitudes_citas c
SET doctor_id = el.doctor_id,
    horario_asignado = el.slot,
    especialidad_id = esp.esp_id,
    estado = CASE WHEN el.doctor_id IS NULL THEN 'sin_asignar' ELSE 'pendiente_aprobacion' END
FROM esp
LEFT JOIN elegido el ON TRUE
WHERE c.id = esp.cita_id
RETURNING c.id, c.estado, c.doctor_id, c.horario_asignado;
